description: Thomas Coopers Wheat Malt Extract, produced by brewers for brewers, is an excellent adjunct for brews where softer mouth-feel and improved head retention is required. Available in 1.5kg cans. Colour - 65EBC
name: Wheat Malt Extract (Coopers)

description: Malted wheat for use in Wheat beers
name: Wheat Malt, Bel

description: Dark malted wheat base for use in dark wheat styles such as Dunkleweizen.
name: Wheat Malt, Dark

description: Darker wheat malt, used as a base malt in many wheat styles. Wheat beers, Koelsch, Alts.
name: Wheat Malt, Dark (Weyermann)

description: Malted wheat base for use in all wheat styles
name: Wheat Malt, Ger

description: Pale wheat malt, used as a base malt in many wheat styles. Wheat beers, Koelsch, Alts.
name: Wheat Malt, Pale (Weyermann)

description:
Flaked wheat adds to increased body and foam retention
Used in place of raw or torrified wheat for faster conversion and better yield.May be used in small amounts to improve head retention and body
Examples: Belgian White beer, Wit
name: Wheat, Flaked

description: Wheat malt can be added at 5% to most light beers to increase foam stability without affecting haze or flavour. Used up to 70% as a base malt for wheat beer, it imparts a bready flavour and characteristic citrus notes.
name: Wheat, Malt (Simpsons)

description: Also called Chocolate Wheat Malt.  Kilned raw wheat - adds a deep, dark brown color to dunkelweizens and other dark beer styles. Roasted, woody, charcoal or burnt toast flavor depending on degree of roasting.
name: Wheat, Roasted

description:
Unmodified wheat that has been"popped"to open the kernels
Used primarily in place of raw wheat when making Belgian White and WitFaster conversion and higher yield than raw wheat
Protein rest recommended when mashing
name: Wheat, Torrified

description: Unmalted wheat torrified for use in a single step infusion.  Typically used for Wits and other wheats where raw unmalted wheat is called for.
name: Wheat, Torrified (Thomas Fawcett)

description:
White wheat gives a malty flavor not available from raw wheat.
Used in Weiss, Wit and White beers
name: White Wheat Malt
